caption: The drawing depicts a curved, horn-shaped object centrally positioned, with intricate decorative patterns engraved along its surface. The horn is shaded in tones of brown, with lighter tans and yellows forming the main body and darker browns marking the ends and engraved designs. One end of the horn is closed off by a circular cap, while the other end features a protruding spout capped by a circular stopper. To the left and lower right of the horn are two smaller objects, both elongated and cylindrical with pointed tips; the top left object has a carved or textured tip, while the lower right object includes a round, flattened element attached to the tip, resembling a disc. The drawing is set against a plain, off-white background, and includes the name "Wm McAulay 37." in the bottom right corner.
title: Powder Horn
